keys.name: orders.poison-prefix
keys.doc: POC hook: an order whose reference starts with this prefix fails in the consumer, to show redelivery and the DLQ

keys.name: orders.relay-batch-size
keys.doc: Outbox rows published per relay tick

keys.name: mp.messaging.outgoing.orders-out.address
keys.doc: AMQP address the outbox relay publishes order events to

keys.name: mp.messaging.incoming.orders-in.address
keys.doc: AMQP address (queue) the order consumer reads; the same address for the POC's loop

keys.name: orders.jms.notifications-queue
keys.doc: JMS queue of the notification variation

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.jdbc.url
keys.doc: JDBC URL of the application database (Agroal pool)

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.password
keys.doc: Database password, delivered from the vault

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.jdbc.max-size
keys.doc: Upper bound of the connection pool

keys.name: quarkus.transaction-manager.node-name
keys.doc: XA recovery node name: unique per instance (EAP: the server name)

keys.name: quarkus.transaction-manager.object-store.directory
keys.doc: XA transaction log: persistent, node-local, outside the release directory (EAP: standalone/data/tx-object-store)

keys.name: amqp-password
keys.doc: Broker password, delivered from the vault

keys.name: amqp-use-ssl
keys.doc: TLS to the broker (with the TLS registry, cookbook 12)

keys.name: quarkus.http.port
keys.doc: API port, the load balancer target
